o1: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; hemidesmosome assembly; regulation of Notch signaling pathway; negative regulation of microtubule severing during mitosis; and positive regulation of microtubule severing during meiosis. Predicted to be active in nuclear speck. Is located in the cytoplasm. Orthologous to human HECTD1 (HECT domain E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1).
